root_cause.text: The probe function in the MediaTek MDP driver fails to properly release acquired resources (m2m device and VPU platform device reference) on subsequent error paths after successful registration, and lacks a NULL check for the VPU device, leading to resource leaks and potential null pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check for `vpu_get_plat_device()` and a new error label `err_reg_handler` that calls `platform_device_put(mdp->vpu_dev)` and `mtk_mdp_unregister_m2m_device(mdp)` before the existing `v4l2_device_unregister`. The commit message explicitly states these fixes.

candidates.rationale: No NULL check on the return value of vpu_get_plat_device, which can return NULL; subsequent use will cause null pointer dereference.
Dereferences mdp->vpu_dev without verifying it is not NULL, directly risking a null pointer dereference.
Jump to error label that only unregisters v4l2 device, failing to release the m2m device and VPU platform device reference, causing resource leaks.
Subsequent allocation call that, upon failure, jumps to the same incomplete cleanup, contributing to resource leak.
Second goto to incomplete cleanup, missing release of previously acquired m2m device and VPU reference.
The error handler at err_m2m_register only performs this single cleanup, omitting necessary release of m2m device and VPU platform device.
